Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1248
Claimant:
Charles Johnson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
03/24/2024
Claim received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
05/03/2024
Reviewed the first notice of loss and the initial statements. The other driver confirms the accident happened as
described, and the scene photos are consistent with that account.
05/06/2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney to confirm the injury claim is for a knee injury. The attorney has been asked to
provide the medical records and any prior treatment history for that area.
06/17/2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Two witness statements
also agree with the sequence of events as reported.
06/19/2024
Inspected the vehicle. The damage pattern matches the impact described by all parties, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior records or the body shop history.
06/29/2024
Reviewed the claimant's statements from each contact so far. The account has stayed the same in every
conversation, with no change in the sequence of events or the position of the vehicles.
09/03/2024
Received the initial medical report. It is not yet clear whether the knee injury was caused by this crash, and the
treating provider has not yet linked the condition to the collision.
09/14/2024
Records from the claimant's prior care show a small strain in the same area sveeral years ago. That strain healed
fully, and the file notes it for comparison purposes only.
09/17/2024
Treatment has followed a usual course, with visits tapering as the patient improved. The billing and tretament dates
have been logged and are being reviewed against the recovrey timeline.
09/30/2024
Confirmed that nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the coverage start date. The driver is
a household member of the policyholder and is covered as such under the policy.
10/20/2024
Causation for the knee injury remains open pending the full medical review. Next steps are to request the complete
treatment notes from the provider and to schedule a follow-up with the attorney's office.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
